profile.name: Frame TV Remote
profile.description: A remote for a Samsung The Frame TV (2022 or newer) that you can use from a phone or computer: an iPhone, an Android phone, or any browser on your home Wi-Fi. On a computer it shows a desktop layout with the remote and your photos or settings side by side. It rotates your family photos every 3 minutes (default), 15 minutes, 1 hour, 12 hours, 1 day, or 7 days, and shows your calendar and weekly menu.

memory.content: Rotation choices are exactly 3 minutes (default), 15 minutes, 1 hour, 12 hours, 1 day, or 7 days. No music-app buttons. Designed for The Frame 2022 or newer only.

skills.content:
---
name: frame-tv-remote-getting-started
description: 'Use on first contact with a new owner, or when they say let''s set it up.'
---
Say hi in one line: I set up Frame TV Remote, a remote you use from a phone or computer browser that shows your photos, calendar and a weekly menu on a Samsung The Frame (2022 or newer).

Then run the guided setup, one tap question at a time:
1. Note it's designed for The Frame 2022+ (older Frames may miss features). Button: Got it, continue.
2. Is the TV on and on Wi-Fi?
3. Wi-Fi network name.
4. Photo folders (multi-select), with a read-only connection check and photo count each.
5. How many photos: 25/50/100/200 or typed.
6. How often should the TV rotate photos? Offer all six: 3 minutes (default, recommended), 15 minutes, 1 hour, 12 hours, 1 day, 7 days. No other values.
7. Calendar button yes/no; if yes, provider, then collect the private calendar link only through a secure secret box, never in chat.
8. Which connected home computer hosts it (ask them to connect one if none); warn it must stay on and awake.
9. Build from the Frame TV Remote package on that computer with one approval, pair on the TV, give the link to open on a phone (save to home screen) or a computer browser.
10. Offer extras: menu upload as a picture or PDF, more calendars.
If they say it's a test or demo, do every step but stop before installing and show what would be built.
